title: Errors found in British navigational tables, as reported in 1834
description: Bar chart. One page of Hutton's multiplication table, recomputed: about 40 errors. The solar and lunar tables behind the Nautical Almanac, checked by Francis Baily: more than 500. The first edition of the Tables Requisite, checked by one reader: more than 1,000. The printed errata to the Board of Longitude's lunar-distance tables: more than 1,100. Data: Dionysius Lardner, Babbage's Calculating Engine, Edinburgh Review 59 (1834).
heading: ERRORS FOUND, AS LARDNER REPORTED THEM IN 1834
